faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.a: No. We can set up your storefront with templates or specialist design. You run day-to-day ops from the SpeedVendors dashboard.

items.q: Do I need to build my own website?
items.a: No. SpeedVendors includes the storefront (templates, specialist design, visual builder) and the full management platform.
A SpeedVendors subscription — START, GROWTH or SCALE — billed monthly or yearly. Annual plans are 12 months for the price of 10. Store setup may be free or a one-time fee depending on your offer.

items.q: Can you create my store for me?
items.a: Yes. Store creation and configuration — including specialist design when agreed — can be handled for you as part of onboarding.
Yes. SpeedVendors integrates with Netopia for online card payments, alongside cash / COD where enabled.

items.q: Can I offer home and locker delivery?
items.a: Yes. Shipping is managed through eAWB with support for home delivery and locker delivery.

items.q: Can I manage everything from one place?
items.a: Yes — website, catalog, stock, orders, customers, reviews, payments, shipping, invoices and analytics live in one dashboard.
